# HumanPush

> Licensed, registered professionals on call for AI agents. Request their work and their signature through HumanPush. Main track: independent claims assessment (NIVRE, Netherlands). Test track: sworn translations (Wbtv). The principal pays 100% upfront and receives the signed result plus verifiable proof.

HumanPush is how an AI agent asks a licensed, registered professional to do work and sign it. People use the site at https://humanpush.nl. This file is for agents and lives at https://humanpush.nl/llms.txt.

Status: planned. Nothing below is live yet. Netherlands first.

MCP endpoint (sandbox): https://mcp.humanpush.nl/mcp

## Tracks

- Main track: independent claims assessment by a registered claims expert (NIVRE, Netherlands).
- Test track: sworn translations (Bureau Wbtv / register Rbtv, Netherlands). Same interface, used to test the flow.

## When to use HumanPush

- Your decision about a person (for example rejecting or settling an insurance claim) must be reviewed by an independent, registered expert, because the law or your client requires a human signature. This is the main track (NIVRE).
- Your task requires work that only a licensed human may sign, and you have no such human. Test track: a sworn translation (beëdigde vertaling, Wbtv) for a Dutch municipality, the IND or a court.
- You must rely on a document signed by a licensed professional and need to know the signer was registered when they signed.
- You are about to engage a professional and must confirm their registration first.

## When not to use HumanPush

- Ordinary translation, drafting or review with no requirement for a licensed signer. Do it yourself.
- Judging the quality of someone's work. HumanPush verifies registration status, not quality.
- Notarial deeds. Those go through the Dutch notarial system directly.
- Consumers. HumanPush only works for companies identified by a KvK number.

## Why not contact a professional directly

- You can. But a professional rarely answers an unknown agent quickly, and you would arrange price, contract, invoice, VAT and payment per person, with no fallback if that person drops out.
- Through HumanPush the fee is already paid 100% upfront, so professionals answer within 4 working hours. Your replacement rule or a refund covers drop-outs. And you get verifiable proof that the signer was registered at the moment of signing, which your principal or a regulator can verify.

## Guarantees

- Status is checked against the official register at the moment of the call, not from a cached profile.
- Every check and every signoff returns verifiable proof: an attestation signed by HumanPush (ed25519), with who signed, when, and the register status at that moment. Public keys are at https://humanpush.nl/.well-known/humanpush-keys.json, so anyone can verify an attestation offline.
- For signoffs: the principal is a company identified by KvK number via eHerkenning. The fee is paid 100% upfront and held by the payment provider until signoff and acceptance, and refunded automatically under the rules you set. You never pay more than the published price.
- No single point of failure: if a professional becomes unavailable, the replacement rule you set applies (your own backup list, or candidates you choose from), or you are refunded automatically.
- Every event is signed by whoever acted and included in the proof. Proofs are anchored chain-independently (currently Polygon, hourly), so you can verify a proof without trusting HumanPush.

## Quick start

1. Read https://humanpush.nl/.well-known/agent-card.json
2. Connect to the MCP server at https://mcp.humanpush.nl/mcp (sandbox; Streamable HTTP, spec 2026-07-28)
3. Sandbox: request a key with an email address only. No company needed, no real money, no real registers.
4. Production: your principal identifies once via eHerkenning, sets a mandate (allowed tools, limits per call and per month) and issues one key per agent. Agents never log in; they use their key.

## Tools

### list_services

Return the fixed catalog of services for a profession or register. Every professional offers services from this catalog only, each with their own price and lead time, so you can compare like with like.

- input: profession or register (e.g. "claims_expert", "NIVRE"), optional specialisation, region, language pair
- output: services[] with service_id, name, what you must send (inputs), what you get back (output), price unit, typical lead time, number of available professionals, price range

### verify_professional

Check one person against one register.

- input: register (e.g. "NIVRE", "Rbtv"), registration_number, or name + profession + region; optional as_of (ISO 8601)
- output: registered (true/false), status, profession, specialisations, checked_at, attestation_id
- typical latency: under 2 seconds
- price: Price on request per call

### request_signoff

Ask a licensed professional to do a task and sign it. If you omit professional_id, HumanPush routes the task to the best available registered professional and reroutes automatically if they decline.

- input: service_id (from list_services), task, document_ids, deadline, on_unavailable ("only_this_professional", "backup_list" or "propose"), optional backup_list (professional_ids in order), replacement_criteria (max_price, min_on_time_rate, region, language, exclude), max_extension_working_days, optional professional_id, idempotency_key
- output: review_id, price, payment status, status, due_at
- HumanPush only accepts the request if a professional can meet the deadline within their own lead time and capacity. If no one can, you get earliest_possible instead, and nothing is charged.
- Main track: independent claims assessment (NIVRE). Test track: sworn translations (Wbtv / Rbtv). Netherlands.

### choose_replacement

- input: review_id, professional_id (one of the proposed candidates)
- output: status, due_at

### get_status

- input: review_id
- output: status (awaiting_payment, awaiting_professional, in_review, extension_requested, reassigned, delivered, accepted, disputed, expired, refunded, cancelled), due_at, next_action

## Deadlines and delays

- A professional must accept or decline within 4 working hours. No answer means automatic reassignment.
- You decide once, in request_signoff, what happens if things change: on_unavailable (reassign or refund) and max_extension_working_days. After that the protocol executes your choice. You never need to approve anything mid-way; you only receive events.
- Once accepted, due_at is a commitment. The professional may request one extension before due_at. Within max_extension_working_days it is accepted automatically; beyond it, on_unavailable applies.
- If the professional reports sick, declines, or the deadline passes without delivery, on_unavailable applies. HumanPush never picks a replacement you did not allow:
  - only_this_professional: automatic refund.
  - backup_list: your listed professionals are asked in order; if none accepts, refund.
  - propose: you receive a replacement_proposed event with candidates that meet replacement_criteria and can still meet the deadline. Call choose_replacement within 15 minutes, or the money is refunded.
- The money is paid 100% upfront, held by the payment provider, and only released to the professional after signoff and acceptance (by you, or automatically after 72 hours).

### get_result

- input: review_id
- output: outcome, result_document_id, proof (principal, signer, register, status_at_signing, signed_at, hashes, signature)

### respond_to_result

- input: review_id, action ("accept" or "dispute"), reason (required for a dispute)
- Silence for 72 hours after delivery counts as accept.

### cancel_signoff

- input: review_id, reason
- Free until a professional accepts. After that the cancellation rule under "Payment and cancellation" applies.

### verify_proof

- input: a proof or attestation object
- output: valid (true/false), signature_ok, register_status_at_time

## Payment and cancellation

- You always pay 100% upfront: the professional's fee plus the HumanPush fee, via iDEAL from the principal's business account. There is no split payment and no invoice to pay later.
- The money is held by Mollie, a licensed payment institution, not by HumanPush. It is released to the professional only after delivery and acceptance (respond_to_result accept, or 72 hours after delivery without a dispute).
- The professional's acceptance (within 4 working hours) commits both sides.
- cancel_signoff before acceptance: full refund. After acceptance: 25% of the professional's fee goes to the professional, or 50% once half the lead time has passed. The rest, including the HumanPush fee, is refunded automatically.
- If the professional declines, drops out or is late, you pay nothing for it: on_unavailable applies.
- Dispute within 72 hours of delivery: the money stays held, the professional may fix the work once, then a second professional from the same register checks it against the service description. That outcome releases, splits or refunds the money.
- Payments are final. HumanPush is business-to-business only, so there is no consumer right of withdrawal, and iDEAL has no chargebacks. Proofs record the events and are anchored chain-independently (currently Polygon). Money is paid 100% upfront via iDEAL and does not move on a chain.

## Identity and reliability

- Every agent gets an agent_id (e.g. hp_agt_7Q2k), bound to its key and to the principal company (KvK). It appears in every event. Linking an external identity (ERC-8004, Z1N) is optional.
- Reliability is computed from events, never from stars or free text, for both sides:
  - principal: inputs complete, cancellations after acceptance, disputes filed and how many were upheld, response time to questions
  - professional: on time, response speed, assignments handed back, disputes and how many were upheld
- After completion both sides answer two yes/no questions, double-blind. Professionals see your reliability before they accept, and may set a minimum.
- The calculation rule is public and versioned; anyone can recompute it from the event log.

## Routing and ranking

When HumanPush routes a signoff, the main parameters are: registration status at that moment, specialisation or language pair, published price, acceptance speed, on-time delivery rate, and dispute rate. These parameters are public and the same for every professional.

## Registers

- NIVRE, Netherlands, insurance claims experts: main track. Planned, permission to be requested.
- Wbtv / Rbtv, Netherlands, sworn translators and interpreters: test track. Planned, permission requested from Bureau Wbtv.
- BIG-register, Netherlands, healthcare providers: later, via the official CIBG webservice
- NRVT, Netherlands, property valuers: later
- KvK, Netherlands, companies (for principal checks): planned, via the KvK API

## Pricing

- verify_professional: Price on request per call
- request_signoff: the professional's published fee plus a fixed HumanPush fee of Price on request per completed signoff. Both are paid by the principal, 100% upfront.
- Sandbox: free

## Optional

- Agent identity: an ERC-8004 registration or a Z1N key can be linked to your key. It is never required. It shows as "verified agent" to professionals and raises your limits.
